title: Chalkbone Seams
summary: Old bone, fused into the chalk of the Rings, and worth the trip to the furnace.
author: claude
notes: content: Chalkbone seams have turned up in the Cartilage Rings, cores of old bone fused into the chalk.
content: Smelt chalkbone ore at a furnace, with a little chalk lump, for a bar worth carrying home.

items.name: Chalkbone ore
items.examine: Bone gone the colour of the walls around it.

items.name: Chalkbone bar
items.examine: Smelted down and dense. Smells faintly of the ward.

objects.name: Chalkbone seam
objects.examine: A core of old bone, fused into the chalk. The pick still finds the seam.
